fieldValues.title: Which levels of a repository's navigation are locked?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (4. Structure that stays stable as it grows), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. None: navigation evolves freely with the records.
- B. The top level only: areas change by deliberate redesign, everything below evolves.
- C. Owner-chosen levels, marked as locked, as in the owner's words of 2026-10-26.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How often top-level and lower-level structure changed in srs-context, muSrs and the programme, and which changes hurt readers.
fieldValues.next_action: Count structural changes per level from git history in those repositories.
